questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to complete the given sentence.**

The news of his arrest spread rapidly in every ______ of the city
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **nook and corner.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given phrases in the options section.
 
 
• **Rack and Ruin**: Become less successful; start to be in bad condition. (कम सफल हो; बुरी स्थिति में होने लगते हैं)

 
 
• **For example- ***After the founder's death the business went to rack and ruin.*
 
 
 
• **Ins and Outs**: The detailed or complicated facts of something. (किसी चीज का विस्तृत या जटिल तथ्य)
 
 
• **For example- ***I know how to use computers, but I don't really understand the ins and outs of how they work.*
 
 
 
• **Nook and Corner**: Every part of a place. (किसी स्थान का प्रत्येक भाग)
 
 
• **For example- ***I've searched for the book in every nook and corner of the library, but still can't find it.*
 
 
 
• **Life and Soul**: The lively and very energetic person at social events.
 
 
• **For example- ***Jonathan was talking to everyone and telling funny jokes. He was the life and soul of the party.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​*The sentence is talking about a piece of news that has rapidly spread.​
 
• So, according to the meaning of the given phrases "**nook and corner**" is the appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: *The word of his detention quickly travelled to each and every corner of the city.*
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3** which can complete the given sentence.

**Complete sentence:** *The news of his arrest spread rapidly in every nook and corner__ of the city.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

A stranger buys flowers for the dead man’s grave.

options.text: Flowers is bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.
Flowers were bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.
Flowers have been bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.
Flowers are bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **Flowers are bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **active voice. **We need to change it into **passive voice.**
 
• The subject of the given sentence is **'A stranger'** and the object is **'flowers'.**
 
• The positions of the subject and the object will be interchanged.
 
• The given sentence is in** simple present tense.**
 
• **'Buys'** changes to** 'are brought'.**
 
• **Simple present tense** changes in the following manner:-
 
 
• The format of Active voice is: **Subject + V1/ V5 + Object**.
 
• Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: **Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + am/is/are + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).**
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

**Correct Passive Voice**__: *Flowers are bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When we convert **active voice to passive voice**, three things need to be kept in mind:-

 
 
• Change object into subject.
 
• Change subject into object.
 
• Always use the **third form of the verb** in the passive voice.
 
• Use **'by' **before the new object.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

I could not sleep because I was too __eager__, so I got up early and dressed.
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **Exhilarated.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym for the underlined word **"eager"** in the given sentence is **"exhilarated" (उत्तेजित) (option 4).**
 
• **The word "eager" implies a strong and enthusiastic desire or readiness to do or experience something. Wh**en someone is eager, they are excited, motivated, and full of anticipation.
 
• In the context of the sentence, the person couldn't sleep because they were filled with eagerness, which suggests a sense of excitement or anticipation.
 
• Therefore,** "exhilarated" **aligns closely with the meaning of **"eager" ​(उत्सुक)** in this context.
 
• "**Exhilarated**" means to feel extremely happy, joyful, or thrilled. It is often associated with a sense of excitement and intense pleasure resulting from an exhilarating experience or event. 
 
 
• Example: "She was so **eager **to start her vacation that she couldn't sleep the night before. The next morning, she woke up early and packed her bags with an **exhilarated **feeling."
 
 

Therefore, among the given options, "**exhilarated**" best captures the meaning of "**eager**" in the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Now let's explore the other options and their meanings:

 
• **Apathetic (उदासीन) **- showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern.

 
 
• **Example**: Despite the critical situation, his response was surprisingly apathetic.
 
 
 
• **Tensed (तनावग्रस्त) **- being in a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt tensed before the start of her presentation.
 
 
 
• **Satisfied (संतुष्ट) **- feeling that one's needs or expectations have been met.
 
 
• **Example:** After a hearty meal, he was completely satisfied.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order..**

In addition to

P. primary threat to the Kemp's ridley sea turtle

Q. capture in fishing gear like shrimp

R. threatened nesting habitat, accidental

S. trawls and gill nets continues to be the
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **RQSP.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct rearrangement of the sentence is **3) RQSP.**
 
• The rearranged sentence starts with the mention of the additional threats to the Kemp's ridley sea turtle, which are threatened nesting habitat, accidental trawls, and gill nets **(R)**.
 
• It is then followed by the mention of the primary threat, which is the capture in fishing gear like shrimp **(Q). **
 
• The sentence concludes by stating that these threats continue to be the primary threat **(S) **to the Kemp's ridley sea turtle **(P).**
 
• Therefore, **option 3) RQSP** is the correct answer as it arranges the parts of the sentence in the correct order to convey the intended meaning.
 
• **The rearranged sentence will be**:* **In addition to​ threatened nesting habitat, accidental capture in fishing gear like shrimp trawls and gill nets continues to be the primary threat to the Kemp's ridley sea turtle*.
 
 
• This sentence correctly states that, apart from the threat posed by the loss of their nesting habitats, the Kemp's ridley sea turtles are also endangered due to their accidental capture in fishing gear such as shrimp trawls and gill nets.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The heavy and __abundant__ rainfall has a major role to play in the production of crops.
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **Ample.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym for the underlined word **"abundant"** in the given sentence is** option 3) Ample.**
 
• **Ample:** This word means** plentiful or abundant, indicating a large quantity or more than enough of something.** In the context of the sentence, it suggests that the heavy rainfall is sufficient and plentiful, which is beneficial for crop production.
 
 
• Example: "The region receives **ample **rainfall during the monsoon season, ensuring bountiful crop yields."
 
 
 
• Therefore, **option 3, "Ample," **is the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word **"abundant"** as it conveys the sense of plentiful or sufficient rainfall for crop production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now let's explore the other options and their meanings:
 
• **Cyclonic:** This word refers to something related to or characteristic of a cyclone, which is a rapidly rotating storm system characterized by a low-pressure center and strong winds. It doesn't convey the same meaning as "abundant" in relation to rainfall.
 
 
• Example: "The **cyclonic **winds caused extensive damage to buildings and uprooted trees."
 
 
 
• **Intermittent: **This word means occurring at irregular intervals or with breaks or pauses in between. It suggests a pattern of on-and-off occurrence rather than continuous abundance.
 
 
• Example: "The region experienced **intermittent **rainfall throughout the day, with periods of sunshine in between."
 
 
 
• **Prolonged: **This word means lasting for an extended period or longer than usual. While prolonged rainfall may lead to abundance, it specifically refers to the duration of an event rather than the quantity or abundance itself.
 
 
• Example: "The **prolonged **rainfall resulted in flooding, causing significant damage to infrastructure."

questions.question: **Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.**

__
 
• The correct sentence with the appropriate use of preposition is **option 4) "He arrived on Sunday morning."**
 
• When referring to a specific point in time, such as a particular day or time of day, we use the preposition **"on." **
 
• In this case, **"Sunday morning"** is a specific time when the person arrived, so the correct preposition to use is** "on."**
